lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: interpreting model parameters in context

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: Quantity A grows by 24 units each year. Quantity B doubles or triples each year, with ratio 3, starting from a much smaller value. Which statement is true in the long run?
choices: A stays ahead permanently because 24 is larger than 3.
The two grow at the same eventual rate.
B eventually exceeds A and stays ahead, however large A’s constant increase is.
B exceeds A only if B starts larger than A.

items.prompt: An asset's value is modelled by V(t) = 3900(0.88)^t, with t in years. What does 0.88 represent?
choices: the total value lost over the asset's life
the number of years until the asset is worthless
the value of the asset when it was new, $3900
the fraction of value retained each year, 0.88, meaning a 12% annual loss

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A linear model passes through (4, 9) and (7, 15). Write it in the form f(x) = mx + b.
A table of successive outputs reads 19, 23, 27, 31. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
choices: Quadratic; the second differences are constant.
Exponential; successive outputs have a constant ratio of 4.
Linear; successive outputs differ by a constant 4.
Neither; the pattern does not repeat.

items.prompt: A population of 1900 grows by 15% per year. Write the model P(t) and find the population after 5 years, to the nearest whole number.
Quantity A grows by 108 units each year. Quantity B doubles or triples each year, with ratio 3, starting from a much smaller value. Which statement is true in the long run?
choices: B eventually exceeds A and stays ahead, however large A’s constant increase is.
A stays ahead permanently because 108 is larger than 3.
The two grow at the same eventual rate.
B exceeds A only if B starts larger than A.

items.prompt: An asset's value is modelled by V(t) = 1400(0.87)^t, with t in years. What does 1400 represent?
choices: the value of the asset when it was new, $1400
the number of years until the asset is worthless
the total value lost over the asset's life
the fraction of value retained each year, 0.87, meaning a 13% annual loss

items.prompt: A linear model passes through (5, 11) and (8, 20). Write it in the form f(x) = mx + b.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: A table of successive outputs reads 3, 6, 9, 12. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A population of 1400 grows by 20% per year. Write the model P(t) and find the population after 3 years, to the nearest whole number.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
